bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
base=/mnt/c/Users/Owner/Downloads
stage=$(mktemp -d "$base/.gace-learning-commit-XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$stage/commit.py"; rmdir "$stage"' EXIT
cat > "$stage/commit.py" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, subprocess, sys, json
root=Path(r"F:\G-ACE-KB")
repo=root/"repo"
def git(*args):
    p=subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(repo),*args],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8",errors="replace",timeout=90)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError("GIT_"+args[0]+"_FAILED "+p.stderr[:1500])
    return p.stdout.strip()
assert git("branch","--show-current")=="codex/main/dev-kb-learning-20261128"
assert git("rev-parse","HEAD")=="f7ed3958b762306910c0938ad7780c2bf72d98af"
files={
"scripts/learning_asset_contract.py":"20d4929e4c1d7068c945bf806cb52eacad6ab458b8ea2dad2cf39e035dfd9b64",
"scripts/learning_asset_store.py":"ca4abdbaaa495c64e71adaa02199c1a7dab3c818d97f3fe79e5ecd87e624a6d2",
"tests/test_learning_asset_contract.py":"6dd2c0f2dd559412e0dad9592406a5a53b25140a460463c55221d57a38556b2a",
"tests/test_learning_asset_store.py":"bf31e6ada5d1cbfaa185c2ed0ce0e9ef6a4709f68a191aa618474e14a036d18b"}
for p,h in files.items(): assert hashlib.sha256((repo/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,p
sys.path.insert(0,str(repo/"scripts"))
from learning_asset_store import verify
out=verify(root)
assert out["status"]=="PASS"
assert len(out["datasets"])==1 and out["datasets"][0]["records"]==73
assert out["datasets"][0]["archive_sha256"]=="c96907f0b9c70110c7697e6be76b26b6680bb210977f1881826167aa76e10643"
print("REAL_STORE_READBACK="+json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=True),flush=True)
docs=["docs/DESIGN_DELTA.md","docs/PROJECT_TREE.md"]
for p in docs: assert "learning_asset_store.py" in (repo/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert git("diff","--cached","--name-only")==""
assert set(git("diff","--name-only").splitlines())<=set(docs)
wf=".github/workflows/reusable-asset-kb-verify.yml"
f=repo/wf
raw=f.read_bytes()
nl=b"\r\n" if b"\r\n" in raw else b"\n"
anchor=b"      - name: Node syntax gate"+nl
assert raw.count(anchor)==1
step=nl.join([b"      - name: Isolated learning candidate intake tests",b"        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_learning_asset_*.py' -v",b"",b""])
raw=raw.replace(anchor,step+anchor)
anchor=b"      - name: Exercise Scheduled Task installer on Windows PowerShell"+nl
assert raw.count(anchor)==1
step=nl.join([b"      - name: Setup Python 3.13 for learning tests",b"        uses: actions/setup-python@v5",b"        with:",b"          python-version: '3.13'",b"",b"      - name: Isolated learning candidate intake tests on Windows",b"        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_learning_asset_*.py' -v",b"",b""])
f.write_bytes(raw.replace(anchor,step+anchor))
paths=list(files)+docs+[wf]
git("add","--",*paths)
assert set(git("diff","--cached","--name-only").splitlines())==set(paths)
git("diff","--cached","--check")
print("STAGED_SOURCE_ONLY="+json.dumps(paths),flush=True)
print(git("commit","-m","feat(kb): admit audited learning candidates in isolated local store"),flush=True)
head=git("rev-parse","HEAD")
print("LOCAL_COMMIT="+head,flush=True)
print("REMAINING_STATUS="+git("status","--short"),flush=True)
branch="refs/heads/codex/main/dev-kb-learning-20261128"
git("push","origin","HEAD:"+branch)
remote=git("ls-remote","--heads","origin",branch)
assert remote.split()[0]==head
print("REMOTE_READBACK="+remote,flush=True)

PY
ps=/mnt/c/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe
win_stage="C:\\Users\\Owner\\Downloads\\$(basename "$stage")"
"$ps" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "& 'D:\Development\Runtime\Python313\python.exe' -B '$win_stage\commit.py'; exit \$LASTEXITCODE"
